name: Primary Health Properties Plc
source: Audited group cash flow statement for the year ended 31 December 2025, Primary Health Properties PLC preliminary results statement (pages 36), GBP millions scaled to pounds: net cash flow from operating activities 179 (2024: 136); payments to acquire and improve investment properties and non-current assets (53) (2024: (21)), carried as the capital expenditure line; net cash flow used in investing activities (464) (2024: (21)), which includes the Assura acquisition of (443) and therefore is not capital expenditure; net cash flow from financing activities 301 (2024: (114)); increase in cash 16 (2024: 1). Free cash flow 126 (2024: 115) is operating cash flow plus capex. FY2023 and FY2022 columns are carried from the previously stored Yahoo Finance series and are not audited here; their capex was never collected, so free cash flow for those two years is withheld rather than restated from operating cash flow.
